question: Four point charges are placed at the vertices of a square of side a. The charges are $+q$, $+2q$, $+4q$, and $+3q$ in a counter-clockwise order starting from the top-left vertex. Analyze the superposition of the electric fields from these charges at the center of the square. What is the magnitude of the net electric field at the center?
